node.title: The XR final assembly: three tools partition the distance scales
node.statement: For a fixed post-strip pair, bound |A| by the exhaustive per-scale split: (i) CLOSE pairs (exchange distance <= ledger reach s_L): residual systems suppress at a q-FACTOR per step (#152's mechanism); (ii) FAR-ONLY sets (distance-s independent): Delsarte/anticode bounds at (j/n) per step; (iii) STRUCTURED mass (link-dense): the KMS/globalness route (juntas = tangent-paid). The wall closes iff the three coverages overlap — determined by xr_radius_arithmetic. The dichotomy is exhaustive by construction; the assembly is the wall.
node.notes: Integrated from Codex (referee pass): status reconciled to PROVABLE (artifacts + all-green predicates); the globalness edge promoted ev -> req per the sketch's own text ('a required input, not merely evidence').
